# profile: # One check per line, separated by tabs. Profile ids are the ones in method/profiles.md.
# `requirements`: what has to be on the machine before installing; runs first, on its own.
# `all`: the access everyone needs, checked together with each profile's own.
# `configured`: a cheap local test that the access is set up (the credential file exists, a
# login is stored). With it, a failing check reads "configured but not answering".
# /establish replaces the examples with the checks of this organisation.
